title: Queued VIXEN builds need an elastic-core compatibility fallback
body: The live box queue admitted the VIXEN editor build but failed inside box-queue-core with unexpected argument 'true'. The documented build only became usable after rerunning with UT_QUEUE_DYNAMIC_FLOW=0 UT_QUEUE_JOBSERVER=0. The queue/build contract should detect this host capability and select a supported admission path automatically.

title: Staged RenderGraph UI guards need a declared asset-root runner
body: The UI guard binaries built successfully but invoking them from the repository/build root failed because assets/ui was absent (the combined CPU guard also segfaulted). The witnesses only ran after manually cd-ing into the staged bundle's assets/.. directory. The test harness should publish and consume its staged asset root declaratively.

title: VIXEN CTest GPU properties need semicolon-safe environment serialization
body: ctest --test-dir build/wsl -N could not parse generated CTestTestfile.cmake because ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION serialized VK_ADD_IMPLICIT_LAYER_PATH with an unescaped semicolon. GPU witnesses had to bypass CTest and invoke the producers directly with the generated environment. The CTest generator should escape/list-encode environment modifications safely.

title: Undertow parity witness needs a clean d11 provider worktree
body: The assigned Undertow pair is pinned to c1e6dff4, while the required d11 kernel is a2614dee; provider-root.sh --explain correctly fails closed because the current provider checkout is divergent and the VIXEN d11 source cache is not a git repository. The parity workflow needs a documented clean lane/worktree provisioning route for the exact kernel revision before the author CLI can be rebuilt.
